title: Skill Ladder
short_answer: Observable skills tied to this manual and Job Check — not hours alone, not invented certifications.
summary: Move up when a lead can see you do the work to standard: stocking without wrecking board, hang without forced sheets, coats that match Job Check, and the judgment to stop for COs and rated walls.
plain_words: Move up when a lead can see you do the work to standard: stocking without wrecking board, hang without forced sheets, coats that match Job Check, and the judgment to stop for COs and rated walls. Titles vary; the skills below are what we will stand behind.
when_to_use: Training conversations between lead and crew
Deciding readiness for independent trade work
prerequisites: Your First Week checklist in progress or complete
Lead available for QC sign-off walks

tools.name: Field Manual checklist runs (shared per job)
Job Check (stage SoT — not training checklists)

steps.title: Checklist runs
steps.body: Use Field Manual checklist runs on a real job — shared with the crew.

steps.title: Lead QC walk
steps.body: Lead walks QC with you before calling a stage done.

steps.title: Training vs Job Check
steps.body: No Monday writeback from training checklists — Job Check stays the stage SoT.

variations.title: Helper
changes: You can show: safe stocking, scrape assist, clean-out, stop when unsure
Manual path: Stocking Any Material + Safety Orientation + Don't Do This

variations.title: Trade hand
changes: You can show: independent hang OR finish coats OR ACT layout to QC standard
Manual path: Hanging OR Finishing OR Acoustical Ceilings (one lane)

variations.title: Multi-trade
changes: You can show: two of the above + pre-board walk + honest Job Check updates
Manual path: Pre-Board Walk + Portal Tools + QC Walk

variations.title: Lead
changes: You can show: crew brief, CO discipline, rated stop authority, end-of-day close
Manual path: Lead Day + Escalation Ladder + Change Order

variations.title: Ops lead
changes: You can show: multi-job prep truth, pull criteria, private brief discipline
Manual path: Morning Prep & Huddle + Escalation + Portal Tools

common_mistakes.right: Job Check only when production stage is true
